title: Red Hat Security Advisory: git-lfs security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security update for git-lfs addressing two vulnerabilities: a denial of service via excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames (CVE-2026-78669) and man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates (CVE-2026-111943). Git Large File Storage (LFS) manages large files in Git repositories by replacing them with text pointers and storing the actual content remotely. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security and affects multiple Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 variants. Users are advised to apply the provided update to mitigate these issues.
